messages:
marta: Quick flag 11 customer asked why their route silently fell back during a rollout and wanted a full audit timeline. Our Console just shows 'fallback happened' with no timeline. Can we add a playback?

josh: +1. We need a 'decision playback' that shows events in order: trigger metric, policy eval, chosen mode (degrade/read-only/proxy), operator action (auto/human), and model switch.

rachel: From compliance side we also need retention & redaction rules. Some customers require 90-day non-redacted audits, others need PII removed. We should add per-account audit-retention and a redaction toggle.

marta: UX idea: in the Rollouts tab show a small timeline pill that expands into a compact play bar. Steps have short labels and can be filtered by reason (latency, error-rate, quota).

devon: Telemetry implications: we'll emit a fallback_audit event with structured fields. Minimal proto:```json
{ "event":"fallback_audit","trace_id":"t-987","time":"2025-05-02T03:12:00Z","from":"redwood-xl","to":"redwood-s-medium","reason":"5xx_spike","trigger_value":0.12,"operator":"auto","policy_id":"rollout-canary-v3" }
```We also need an attachable 'evidence_blob' pointer to logs (s3 path) but that must obey redaction policy.

josh: Also add an 'explain' button that runs a small diff between policy versions that were active at the time and highlights rules that matched. Helps SREs and customers.

eng-bot: NOTE: retention policy service reported: default audit retention = 30 days. You can override per-account via billing + legal.

rachel: Can we ensure audit access is RBAC-protected? Only operators with 'rollback' permission can view unredacted audits. Add an audit access log entry when someone views a playback.

marta: Implementation plan: eng-platform to emit fallback_audit + evidence refs (josh), eng-console to add playback UI + redaction toggle (devon + rachel), infra to expose S3 refs with short-lived creds (infra team). I'll create a ticket.

devon: One more edgecase: mixed-degrade where prefix served from origin and remainder from fallback. Playback should show per-span attribution. Use our existing trace-span IDs so UI can stitch.

josh: Will PR for telemetry proto & index by trace_id. Also adding a quick 'why did it fallback' API endpoint for the Console to call.

marta: Sweet. Owners: josh (telemetry), devon (console), rachel (compliance), marta (product). I'll post the ticket and link runbook.
